name: Whole-Wheat Momos
method: Knead dough with sesame oil and salt. Sauté ginger, cabbage, carrots, pepper in olive oil. Fill, pleat, steam 10 min.

name: Thai Green Curry
method: Dry roast spices, blend with aromatics into paste. Sauté veggies, add paste, salt, coconut milk, lemon juice. Serve with rice.

name: Whole-Wheat Pizza
method: Make dough, bake over salt bed in kadhai. Top with blended onion-tomato sauce, cheese, veggies, oregano, chili flakes. Bake 20 min.

name: Honey Chili Potato
method: Boil potatoes 90%, coat in besan, pan-fry. Sauté aromatics, add sauces, mix potatoes and sesame. Cool slightly, drizzle honey.

name: Paneer Tikka Curry
method: Marinate paneer in curd and spices, roast. Sauté masala base, add roasted besan, water, garam masala, paneer. Finish with butter.

name: Palak Paneer Pulao
method: Sauté cumin, onion, whole spices, chili. Add spinach puree, paneer, soaked rice, water. Simmer until cooked.

name: Vegetable Kathi Roll
method: Sauté cumin, onion, spices, ginger. Add veggies and paneer, cook 5 min. Wrap in chapati.

name: Vegetable Corn Soup
method: Boil water with salt, pepper, ginger. Add veggies and grated corn, simmer 10 min. Garnish with lemon and coriander.

name: Soya Biryani
method: Sauté whole spices, onion, ginger, tomato. Add soaked soya, herbs, soaked rice, water. Cook low 15 min.

name: Dal Dhokli
method: Make dough. Sauté cumin, hing, spices, tomato. Add dal and water, simmer. Drop cut dough pieces in, cook 20-25 min.

name: Millet Masala Khichdi
method: Sauté cumin, onion, spices, beans, tomato. Add soaked millets, moong dal, water. Simmer 15-20 min. Garnish with ghee.

name: Healthy Oats Pizza
method: Make batter with oat flour and semolina, spread like pancake. Top with sauce, veggies, cheese. Cover and cook until cheese melts.

name: Beans Pulao
method: Sauté spices, soaked beans and chickpeas. Add soaked brown rice, water. Cook 30 min. Garnish with coriander.

name: Paneer Capsicum Roll
method: Sauté spices, tomato, capsicum, paneer 5 min. Add curd and ketchup. Fill chapati and roll.

name: Veggie Sweet Potato
method: Sauté seeds, onion, spices, diced sweet potato, veggies 10-15 min. Add tamarind water. Serve with curd.

name: Cabbage Sandwich
method: Mix chopped cabbage, curd (or malai), pepper, salt. Sandwich between whole wheat bread.

name: Millet Soya Biryani
method: Sauté spices, onion, tomato, curd. Add soaked soya, herbs, water, soaked millets. Cook 15-20 min.

name: Masala Khichdi
method: Sauté cumin, onion, spices, veggies, tomato. Add soaked rice and moong dal. Cook 15 min. Garnish with ghee.

name: Pasta with Chickpeas & Spinach
method: Boil pasta. Sauté ginger, spinach, tomato, spices. Add boiled chickpeas and pasta.

name: Besan Ka Chila
method: Mix besan, water, veggies, spices into batter. Cook on pan with mustard oil until golden.

name: Tamarind Rice
method: Temper mustard, curry leaves, peanuts, spices. Add tamarind water, cook to a paste. Mix with boiled rice.

name: Almond Banana Milk
method: Blend almonds, bananas and warm milk.

name: Instant Masala Idli
method: Mix sooji, salt, water, baking soda, lemon juice. Steam 15 min. Toss in pan with tempered spices and veggies.

name: Sattu Paratha
method: Knead dough. Mix sattu, spices, mustard oil, lemon juice for stuffing. Roll and roast.

name: Paneer Bhurji Sandwich
method: Sauté spices, tomato, fresh paneer. Sandwich in bread and toast with ghee.

name: Red Rice Poha
method: Wash poha. Temper mustard, peanuts, veggies. Add poha, lemon juice, desi khand. Cook 2-3 min.

name: Banana Oat Smoothie
method: Blend soaked oats, soaked cashews, ripe bananas, cinnamon, chicory powder.

name: Instant Millet Dosa
method: Blend overnight-soaked millet, dals, spices. Add baking soda. Cook on cast iron tawa. Serve with peanut chutney.

name: Moong Sprout Chaat
method: Mix sprouts with veggies, spices, lemon juice and sesame oil.

name: Golden Spice Milk
method: Boil milk with turmeric, cardamom, cinnamon, cloves, pepper.

name: Chocolate Milk
method: Mix warm milk with unsweetened cocoa.

name: Chuare Milk
method: Boil milk with dry dates.

name: Peanut Papad Chaat
method: Top roasted papad with veggies, peanuts, paneer, chaat masala, lemon juice.

name: Masala Bread
method: Sauté veggies and pav bhaji masala. Toss with diced bread.

name: Aloo Chana Chaat
method: Mix boiled chickpeas, potato, curd, ketchup, spices.

name: Mix Veg Pulao
method: Sauté veggies, paneer, spices. Mix with rice and water. Cook until done.

name: Dal Bhel
method: Mix leftover dal with rice, veggies, peanuts, chaat masala.

name: Paneer Popcorn
method: Marinate paneer. Coat in besan batter then semolina. Shallow fry in mustard oil.

name: No Coffee Cold Coffee
method: Dry roast chickpeas to dark brown, grind. Blend with chilled milk and jaggery.

name: Naan Khatai
method: Mix everything, shape, bake over salt in kadhai 10 min.

name: Banana Peanut Butter Ice Cream
method: Blend frozen ripe bananas with jaggery and peanut butter. Freeze 1 hour.

name: Katori Cake
method: Blend batter, pour into katori, top with dry fruits. Bake over salt 40 min.

name: Atte ka Halwa
method: Roast flour in ghee until brown. Mix in warm jaggery water until ghee separates.

name: Gajar ka Halwa
method: Sauté grated carrots in ghee with cardamom, cashews. Add milk, simmer 15-20 min. Mix in jaggery.

name: Walnut Delight
method: Mix beaten curd, crushed walnuts, chopped dates, honey. Chill.

name: Sweet Potato Halwa
method: Mash boiled sweet potatoes. Mix with warm jaggery syrup and a teaspoon of ghee.

name: Healthy Kheer
method: Simmer milk with soaked rice and saffron until thick. Add khand, cardamom, dry fruits.

name: Hostler's Delight (Churi)
method: Spread ghee and jaggery on warm chapati, roll, eat.

name: Coconut Laddoo
method: Make thick syrup of coconut sugar and water. Mix with grated coconut, cool, roll into balls.

name: Sattu Sherbet
method: Mix sattu, water, black salt, lemon juice.

name: Gond Shikanji
method: Soak gond. Mix water, mishri, lemon, pepper, black salt and gond.

name: Cucumber Cooler
method: Blend everything with water.

name: Kacchi Lassi
method: Mix 30-40ml milk with mishri and water.

name: Watermelon Mint Cooler
method: Blend diced watermelon with mint.

name: Jaljeera
method: Blend mint, spices, salts, hing, water. Mix into jaggery and lemon water.

name: Bael Sherbet
method: Extract bael pulp, mix with water, strain. Sweeten with jaggery.

name: Ragi Malt
method: Make ragi paste with water. Boil with water and salt. Cool, mix in lemon juice and curd.

name: Turmeric Milk
method: Boil milk with turmeric, pepper and ghee.

name: Buttermilk (Chaas)
method: Blend herbs, ginger, curd, hing, salts, water. Temper with ghee, cumin, curry leaves.

name: Lemon Honey Water
method: Mix lukewarm water, lemon juice, honey.

name: Carrot Milk
method: Boil grated carrots in water, add milk, boil until water evaporates. Sweeten with honey/jaggery.
